headline: Senate Budget Panel Chair Says No Funding for New Flood-Control Projects in 2027
seoTitle: Senate: No New Flood-Control Projects in 2027 | FMB News
seoDescription: The Senate finance committee chair said the 2027 budget should not fund new flood-control projects while existing projects and backlogs are reviewed.
deck: The Senate budget panel signaled tighter scrutiny of flood-control spending after severe flooding and questions over project performance.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The chair of the Senate finance committee said no funding for new flood-control projects should be included in the 2027 national budget while the government reviews existing projects, implementation backlogs and the performance of flood-mitigation spending.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The position followed widespread flooding in Luzon and renewed scrutiny of Department of Public Works and Highways flood-control projects.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: A pause on new projects would shift attention toward completing, auditing and evaluating existing infrastructure before additional public funds are committed.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The proposed 2027 budget remains subject to committee hearings and plenary deliberations, where project-level allocations can still change.
